name: Winfield

zones.ALL: One schedule for all of Winfield

contact: the Winfield Mutual Housing Management Office (after hours 908-486-5012) or the Township Office, 908-925-3850
notes: Garbage (normal household waste only) is picked up every Tuesday and Friday.

Recycling is every other Friday, collected by Giordano: at the curb the night before or by 6-7 AM. Clean plastics #1, #2 and #5, glass, aluminum, cardboard boxes (flattened and tied), newspapers, magazines, soft-cover books and junk mail, loose in the bin. No Styrofoam, shredded paper or plastic bags of any kind. Giordano does not provide bins: use a blue bin of 32 to 64 gallons, or label another color "RECYCLING". Missed recycling: Giordano, 973-242-2250 ext. 2 (Monday-Friday 8:30 AM-3:00 PM).

Bulky waste is picked up on the last Wednesday of every month: furniture, appliances, sheetrock, wood, carpeting and bedding. Keep it reachable without lifting over parked cars; nothing over 36 inches long except appliances and furniture; tie loose items or put them in containers. Not taken: bulky waste in cardboard boxes or plastic bags, concrete, rocks, patio blocks, bricks, paint cans, car parts, tires, TVs and other electronics.
Refrigerators, freezers and air conditioners need a Freon sticker from the Management Office before they go to the curb.
Leaves and grass clippings must be in a can, bucket or bag, never swept or blown into the street (Township Ordinance 367, fines from $100).
No holiday changes to pickups are published, and Recycle Coach shows none: garbage stays on Tuesday and Friday in holiday weeks. If in doubt, ask the Management Office.
